positions.name: MeridianSignedManifestGate
positions.frame: Is the signed-release-manifest requirement a settled, in-force operational rule for Meridian deploys, and if so what are its scope and ownership terms?
positions.why: src-1 declares the requirement in force ('now requires'), and src-3/src-4/src-5 restate it as a labeled operational record — Gate, Scope, Owner — each performed as ratified rule rather than argued claim (conviction reads all four as decision-grade, register reads all four as protocol-spec headline, relational/power reads all four as authority-ranking legitimate mandate). Together they cohere as one settled declaration of the gate's terms: what it requires, where it applies, who holds it.
